_comment: Orc Warlord cleave (content pass C6, plan-content-zones12.md §B): the boss's single active aura — multi-effect on the Vanguard precedent, because exactly one aura is active at a time (mobs included): a heavier OrcCleave sweep (3 targets, brute physical) PLUS a lingering bleed dot (physical+bleed, DamageBurst's tag pair) that keeps pressure on whoever rotates out. Sustained healer stress between Frenzy windows is the design point (PO kit pick: Cleave + Frenzy + bleed). ⚑ ONE 90-tick beat for BOTH effects (PO 2026-08-02, intake round 7 item 11): the boss swings every 3 s (1.5 s in Frenzy windows) so ducking in and out of range is real play — magnitudes scaled throughput-neutral from the old 35/50-tick pair (cleave 20→50, bleed 6→11). Curve-position-1 baseline. All values [PLACEHOLDER]
